entry.title: MARCO RAMBALDI: The Sanctuary of Self for S/S 27 | Milan Fashion Week

media:group.media:title: MARCO RAMBALDI: The Sanctuary of Self for S/S 27 | Milan Fashion Week
media:group.media:description:
Marco Rambaldi spring/summer ready-to-wear collection 2027 Milan Fashion Week #Rambaldi #SS27 #MFW
Artisanal crochet, wallpaper textures, and exclusive backstage insights from Marco Rambaldi on his Virginia Woolf-inspired collection - enjoy the full S/S 27 showcase on FashionTV!
At Milan Fashion Week, designer Marco Rambaldi staged a poignant, deeply intimate exploration of identity and chosen sanctuary with his spring/summer 2027 collection.
Drawing on Virginia Woolf’s seminal text “A Room of One’s Own” and the candid, humanizing photography of Lisetta Carmi and Nan Goldin, Rambaldi reframed the home not as a place of confinement, but as a site of self-determination, bodily autonomy, and emotional refuge.
The runway showcased a poetic synthesis of craft and vulnerability, featuring wallpaper-patterned textiles, artisanal crochet draped over denim, balloon skirts, and sheer crepe de Chine dresses with theatrical backs.
Backstage, amid an electric atmosphere where makeup artist Rosh Kumarasinghe crafted soft, lived-in beauty looks, Marco Rambaldi shared the collection's core inspiration.
He explained that handmade craftsmanship was his language for honoring chosen families and safe spaces, noting that true liberation begins when we claim our own narratives and turn domestic intimacy into a radical, unyielding celebration of identity.

entry.title: Chiara Ferragni, Leonie Hanne Toast ERMANNO SCERVINO S/S 27 | Milan Fashion Week

media:group.media:title: Chiara Ferragni, Leonie Hanne Toast ERMANNO SCERVINO S/S 27 | Milan Fashion Week
media:group.media:description:
@ermannoscervino Ermanno Scervino Spring/Summer ready-to-wear collection 2027 Milan Fashion Week #ErmannoScervino #SS27 #MFW #LeonieHanne #ChiaraFerragni #RosarioDawson
Go backstage with Ermanno Scervino, Chiara Ferragni, Rosario Dawson, and Leonie Hanne at Milan Fashion Week with FashionTV!
Presented at Piazza Lina Bo Bardi during Milan Fashion Week, Ermanno Scervino delivered a masterclass in Italian sartorial excellence with his spring/summer 2027 collection.
Balancing structural precision with sensual lightness, the runway showcased a dynamic dialogue between sharp, field-inspired tailoring in loden green and fluid, hand-detailed lace slip dresses.
Earthy, utilitarian denim grounded intricate embroidery, proving that true luxury thrives in contrasts.
Backstage buzzed with high fashion and star power: Chiara Ferragni, Valentina Ferragni, Leonie Hanne, and Hollywood icon Rosario Dawson gathered to congratulate designer Ermanno Scervino.
Sharing their impressions with FashionTV, the guests marveled at how the collection seamlessly fused rebellious street energy with delicate atelier craft, noting how structured outerwear over translucent silks captured a modern, unapologetic femininity.

entry.title: SARAH REGENSBURGER Fuses British Tartan and Persian Craft for S/S 27 | London Fashion Week

media:group.media:title: SARAH REGENSBURGER Fuses British Tartan and Persian Craft for S/S 27 | London Fashion Week
media:group.media:description:
Sarah Regensburger spring/summer 2027 ready-to-wear collection London Fashion Week #SarahRegensburger #SS27 #LFW
Experience a deeply personal fusion of heritage, poetry, and ethical design at Sarah Regensburger's spring/summer 2027 show on FashionTV!
Opening the London Fashion Week schedule, German-born, London-based designer Sarah Regensburger delivered her most deeply personal showcase to date with her Spring/Summer 2027 collection, ""Diaspora: The Art of Belonging.""
Grounded in her Iranian heritage and vegan principles, the presentation served as a poetic answer to a life spent negotiating two worlds. The show opened with a Sufi dance set to a DJ Kiki soundtrack, featuring the voices of young Baluchistani women reflecting on freedom.
Each runway look staged a dialogue between Western classics and Persian craft: British tartan suits hand-stitched with Iranian coins, vegan banana leather jackets adorned with traditional Baluchi needlework, catsuits printed with Hafez poetry, and tailoring paired with coastal Bandari masks.
Reflecting light through mirror embellishments inspired by Tehran's Golestan Palace, the cruelty-free collection culminated in the unveiling of her new sub-brand, Panj - named after the Farsi numeral five, which resembles an inverted heart.
Closing the show alongside her mother in matching leaf-printed suits, Regensburger transformed personal heritage and maternal legacy into a radical manifesto of ethical revolution.

entry.title: SPORTMAX: Cool Under Pressure for S/S 27 | Milan Fashion Week

media:group.media:title: SPORTMAX: Cool Under Pressure for S/S 27 | Milan Fashion Week
media:group.media:description:
Sportmax spring/summer ready-to-wear collection 2027 Milan Fashion Week #Sportmax #SS27 #MFW
Experience modern minimalist tailoring crafted for the summer heat - watch Sportmax spring/summer 2027 on FashionTV!
Staged in the sunlit courtyard of Palazzo Litta during Milan Fashion Week, Sportmax unveiled its spring/summer 2027 collection, a sharp, intelligent answer to the intensity of global summer heatwaves.
Conceptually rooted in urban climate adaptation, the runway showcased weightless organza blazers, silk-draped denim, and deconstructed, butter-soft nappa leather with breathable inserts.
Chrome hip rings, structural wired peplums, and Lucite heels anchored monochrome silhouettes in ecru, chocolate brown, and deep midnight blue, proving that high summer dressing can remain scrupulously tailored without sacrificing fluid ease.
Backstage and along the front row, models Uma Jammeh and Violet Grace brought the collection's effortless cool to life, embodying a modern vision of summer tailoring that balances sculptural discipline with complete freedom of movement.

entry.title: B ICONIC: Art & Emerging Vision for S/S 27 | Milan Fashion Week

media:group.media:title: B ICONIC: Art & Emerging Vision for S/S 27 | Milan Fashion Week
media:group.media:description:
B Iconic spring/summer ready-to-wear collection 2027 Milan Fashion Week #BIconic #SS27 #MFW
B Iconic brought the ultimate mix of art, couture, and emerging talent to Milan Fashion Week - watch the highlights on FashionTV!
Staged inside the industrial architecture of Officine del Volo, B Iconic concluded its third edition during Milan Fashion Week, cementing its position as a dynamic global incubator bridging commercial scale, artistic expression, and social advocacy.
Conceived by Giulio Di Sabato, Simone Ruggeri, and Mitch Mihic and produced by Caremoli & Ruggeri, this edition introduced a Pop-up Store & Temporary Showroom in collaboration with Best Showroom, merging traditional runway presentations with direct B2B buyer ordering and retail access featuring brands like Matteo Sorbellini and Korean skincare label Ongju.
Central to the event was its international scouting agenda - bolstered by Fondazione Italia Cina and the Future Moda initiative, which highlighted cross-cultural dialogue through designers including Kimooncho, Li Yuntao, Drycri, Sul Young Hee, Par.lune, Ludovica Milano, Golden Rabbit, Pelliot, Met Jeans, and Massimo Sabbadin.

​@PHILIPPPLEINOFFICIAL Philipp Plein Spring/Summer ready-to-wear collection 2027 Milan Fashion Week #PhilippPlein #SS27 #MFW
Philipp Plein brought full-volume luxury back to Milan Fashion Week! Catch the runway show and the designer's exclusive backstage inspiration now on FashionTV!
At Ippodromo Snai San Siro during Milan Fashion Week, designer Philipp Plein staged a full-throttle show and unveiled his spring/summer 2027 collection, ""The Jet Set Protagonist.""
Reaffirming his title as the undisputed master of maximalist glamour, the runway merged high-energy street edge with opulent resort tailoring.
Distressed denim accented with heavy crystal embellishments, sharp liquid-leather biker jackets, and metallic-woven evening gowns shared the stage with monster trucks, capturing an unapologetic spirit of adventure and high-velocity living.
Backstage, amid the electric atmosphere of models donning studded accessories and high-shine beauty looks, Philipp Plein shared the collection's core inspiration.
He said the lineup was crafted for modern global nomads and jet-setters who live life on their own terms, and that the vision celebrated resilience, bold individuality, and the seamless fusion of cosmopolitan luxury with unrestrained energy.

entry.title: BARBARA RIZZI: Stripping Away the Armor for S/S 27 | Milan Fashion Week

media:group.media:title: BARBARA RIZZI: Stripping Away the Armor for S/S 27 | Milan Fashion Week
media:group.media:description:
Barbara Rizzi spring/summer ready-to-wear collection 2027 Milan Fashion Week #BarbaraRizzi #SS27 #MFW
Backstage & Beyond: Barbara Rizzi talks soul and heritage in an exclusive FTV interview!
Unveiled inside the historic Museo Bagatti Valsecchi during Milan Fashion Week, designer Barbara Rizzi presented her spring/summer 2027 collection, titled ""Anima.""
Moving away from rigid, protective tailoring, the collection explores the tension between vulnerability and strength, peeling back symbolic historical armor to reveal the soul beneath.
Sculptural metallic corsets in gleaming bronze and silver grounded vertical, fluid silhouettes that trace the body in silk chiffon and rich brocade. Grounded in a deeply emotional palette of dark earth brown, control green, and transformative copper, the showcase balanced structured authority with unstudied grace.
Backstage, the energy was palpably intimate as models donned hand-stitched details, while Barbara Rizzi shared the emotional blueprint behind the runway in an exclusive interview with FashionTV.
She explained that the collection was rooted in identity, heritage, and the words her father had written in her baby book, noting that when she passes, grass will no longer grow.
She added that “Anima” was about discovering that true strength did not need to be impenetrable, but could move, breathe, and exist in fluid softness without ever bending.

entry.title: MATIERES FECALES: From Decayed Couture to Louboutin Heels | Paris Fashion Week

media:group.media:title: MATIERES FECALES: From Decayed Couture to Louboutin Heels | Paris Fashion Week
media:group.media:description:
Matieres Fecales spring/summer 2027 ready-to-wear collection Paris Fashion Week #MatieresFecales #PFW #SS27
Experience a historic moment of radical diversity and raw couture at Matieres Fecales' spring/summer 2027 show on FashionTV!
For S/S 2027, designer Steven Raj Bhaskaran and life partner Hannah Rose delivered a historic, deeply personal manifesto with Matieres Fecales: ""The Ninety Nine Percent.""
Staged at Paris’s iconic Place de la Republique - marking the first fashion show in history at this sacred monument of revolution and free speech - the collection featured 99 looks worn exclusively by 99 models of color.
Divided into three chapters (Family, Tribe, and Gods), the runway opened with pure white draped silhouettes honoring Bhaskaran’s mother, Grace, and his multi-faith upbringing, before evolving into modular, cloud-like tulle blazers paired with Louboutin collaboration flip-flop heels.
The Tribe section stormed the square in military tweed, decaying leather capes, and punk metal hardware alongside the brand's new ""Stomper"" boots and ""Golden Touch"" gloves.
The showcase culminated in the Gods section, with hand-woven Burkina Faso cotton suits and Indian Varanasi embroidered sarees transformed into decayed 1950s ballgowns, and closed with models carrying life-sized billionaire figures on their backs as Nina Simone’s voice echoed across Paris.

At Milan Fashion Week, creative director Lorenzo Serafini presented Alberta Ferretti’s S/S 2027 collection, titled ""A Beautiful Escape.""
Defined by sun-bleached hues, fluid silhouettes, and 1920s-inspired lightness, the showcase captured effortless release through bias-cut satin slip dresses, kimono jackets, and delicate fringe details.
Behind the scenes and along the front row, the mood was equally radiant: Italian actress Valeria Bilello joined fashion’s elite backstage, while supermodel Irina Shayk anchored the runway in fluid, movement-focused tailoring that moved gracefully with every step.
Instead of chasing rigid glamour, Serafini delivered a masterclass in modern escapism, proving true luxury lies in freedom, movement, and unstudied elegance.

entry.title: Kylie Jenner Stars in Stella McCartney’s Winter 2026 "Wild Horses" Film

media:group.media:title: Kylie Jenner Stars in Stella McCartney’s Winter 2026 "Wild Horses" Film
media:group.media:description:
Stella McCartney ready-to-wear collection F/W 26 Kylie Jenner #StellaMcCartney #FW26 #RTW #KylieJenner
Immerse yourself in a vision of wild freedom and conscious luxury - watch the Stella McCartney Winter 2026 campaign film now on FashionTV!
Directed by Gia Coppola and conceived by Stella McCartney herself, the brand’s Winter 2026 content series brings together three powerhouse women in a striking ode to human-equine connection.
The visual narrative submerges style icon Kylie Jenner in natural waters alongside a trained horse, prioritizing coexistence over control and placing contemporary glamour directly into the raw beauty of the natural world.
The campaign highlights the house’s new Appaloosa bag, named in tribute to Linda McCartney’s beloved stallion, Lucky Spot, and offers behind-the-scenes glimpses of exclusive “My Little Pony” charms debuting this December.
Beyond the aesthetic, the campaign raises global awareness and support for America’s vulnerable wild horses, reinforcing Stella McCartney's foundational belief that high fashion, animal advocacy, and true sustainability coexist seamlessly.

entry.title: SIMON CRACKER: Rustic Couture for S/S 27 | Milan Fashion Week

media:group.media:title: SIMON CRACKER: Rustic Couture for S/S 27 | Milan Fashion Week
media:group.media:description:
Simon Cracker spring/summer 2027 ready-to-wear collection Milan Fashion Week #SimonCracker #SS27 #MFW
Discover the art of radical upcycling and DIY couture, watch the full Simon Cracker spring/summer 2027 showcase now on FashionTV!
For S/S 2027, designer Simone Botte turns to childhood memories, raw DIY punk ethos, and zero-energy upcycling for the latest Simon Cracker collection: ""Via Francia.""
Rooted in the belief that true luxury lies in creativity rather than high price tags, the collection draws on a summer in Romagna spent creating theater costumes from discarded tablecloths, granny skirts, and vintage curtains.
On the runway, this nostalgic ""playroom-wardrobe"" unfolds through modular, transformable garments that let wearers redefine their silhouettes with hooks and shifting shapes.
Hand-assembled without electricity, the lineup pairs 18th-century ""poor couture"" shapes, deadstock paisley, and plastic-coated leathers with promotional t-shirts merged into elegant gowns.
Hand-painted Dr. Martens, 3D-printed bags made from recycled filaments, and earrings crafted from salvaged beach plastic round out a deeply personal, anti-system showcase that celebrates freedom, individuality, and radical sustainability.

entry.title: PRIVATE POLICY: New York Court Culture & Heritage for S/S 27 | New York Fashion Week

media:group.media:title: PRIVATE POLICY: New York Court Culture & Heritage for S/S 27 | New York Fashion Week
media:group.media:description:
Private Policy S/S 27 ready-to-wear collection New York Fashion Week #PrivatePolicy #SS27 #NYFW
Admire the intersection of sports culture and global identity - watch Private Policy spring/summer 2027 show on FashionTV!
At Daylight Studio during New York Fashion Week, Private Policy unveiled its S/S 2027 collection, ""Stitched, Not Blended.""
Rejecting the pressure to force cultural compromise, co-creative directors Haoran Li and Siying Qu explore how two distinct worlds can coexist in complete wholeness, using New York basketball culture and its massive Mandarin-speaking global fanbase as a powerful metaphor for youth living between cultures.
The collection brings this philosophy to life through sharp contrast: structured, court-inspired outerwear meets fluid organza layers, while deconstructed basketball jerseys, varsity-stripe ribbing, and tailored suits feature exposed, heavy-gauge contrast stitching that holds the garments together.
Nylon utility track pants, oversized bomber jackets, and convertible zip-off sleeves sit alongside refined Mandarin collar shirting and metallic hardware details.
Instead of blending elements into a uniform hybrid, Private Policy allows each fabric, silhouette, and cultural reference to retain its true identity, held in place by visible, resilient seams.
